title: Metric
summary: A metric tile: one number with its label, the change against a previous period said in words and by an arrow, a limit as a meter, the page's status with a hint, an optional sparkline, and the whole tile as one link or button.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

label.description: What the number is, in a few words: the tile's accessible name. Required in practice: without it the tile is named «Показатель».

value.description: The number. Unset, the tile says «—» (data-state auto is then empty).

format.description: number, integer, decimal-<n>, percent (a share 0..1), compact, currency-<CODE> or unit-<Intl unit> (unit-gigabyte, unit-megabit-per-second), in the page's language. The change and the limit are said the same way.

previous.description: The value of the previous period; the change is worked out from it when delta is not given.

delta.description: The change itself, when the page has it; it wins over previous.

delta-format.description: How the change is written: its share of the previous value, the difference in the value's format, or both. Without a previous value it is the difference.

period-text.description: What the change is against, after it: «к прошлой неделе».

better.description: Whether a rise is good: up for sales, down for server load or errors, none when neither. The change's tone follows its meaning, not its sign.

max.description: A limit: the tile shows «value of max» with a meter (storage, a licence, a quota).

limit-text.description: The words under the meter instead of «45 ГБ из 100 ГБ».

status.description: The page's statement about the number, in the shared status vocabulary: a dot of that tone and the hint. Thresholds are the page's; the tile never infers a status from the value.

hint.description: A short line beside the status: «Свободно меньше 10 %».

href.description: Makes the whole tile one link to this address.

openable.description: Without href: makes the whole tile one button that sends open.

size.description: The rung of the size ladder: the value's text, the gaps. 1/2 for a dense row, 2 for a page's headline figure.

data-state.description: auto: ready with a value, empty without («—»). loading holds the tile's size with a skeleton of the value; the error of a load is the status and the hint.

sf-metric-open.summary: The person pressed an openable tile (Enter, Space or a click); the host opens the details.

accessibility.focus: None for a plain tile; one Tab stop for a link or a button tile.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-metric for one number that matters with its change, its limit or its status: a dashboard's row of figures, a server's load, storage, a quota.
do_not: Do not infer a status from the value; the page states it
Do not put buttons or links inside the tile; give it href or openable
Do not colour a change without better; a rise is not always good
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-metric label="Выручка за неделю" value="1250000" previous="1100000" format="currency-RUB"></sf-metric>
